title: Provision the pinned Yeroket snapshot when a VIXEN wave advances its kernel pin
body: After merging VIXEN wave 92804a8f, cmake --preset vixen-wsl failed because pinned Yeroket 8d68e983 was absent from the shared checkout. Recovery required an ignored bare fetch inside this worktree plus explicit -DYEROKET_ROOT and -DVIXEN_KERNEL_CACHE_DIR overrides; the queued configure then passed. Suggested consolidation: resolve and provision the pinned immutable snapshot through the documented configure path without per-lane scratch git/cache wiring.

title: Size queued VIXEN build admission to the actual Ninja job count
body: A queued no-op cmake --build build/wsl -j3 was held over five minutes while the wrapper requested 3 credits and only 2 were free; it was cancelled before the payload ran. Retrying through the same global queue with --credits 1 and cmake --build build/wsl -j1 completed immediately with ninja: no work to do. Suggested consolidation: derive queue credits from the requested job count or admit no-op builds without reserving the full estimate.

title: Expose HDR exposure compensation as typed render configuration
body: R432 requires per-state exposure defaults, but the current render facade has no typed setting for the exposure tonemapper. The fixture currently sets VIXEN_HDR_EXPOSURE_COMPENSATION_EV, and BuildRenderGraph.cpp validates the string then injects a GLSL define into ExposureTonemap.comp. Suggested consolidation: model exposure compensation in render configuration and carry it through the graph without per-scene source injection.

title: Keep repeated look-dev captures in fresh Vulkan processes
body: An initial multi-graph capture attempt reused one Vulkan process and ended in VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST followed by a segfault. The runner now launches each preset in a fresh process and compares the resulting images; this avoids the failure but makes the harness slower and duplicates setup. Suggested consolidation: define and test a supported lifecycle for repeated headless render-graph captures in one process.

title: Align CodegenTool run checks with the built configuration
body: A queued dotnet build of CodegenTool.csproj in Release succeeded, but the subsequent dotnet run --project ... --no-build --check defaulted to Debug and failed to find the Debug executable. Adding --configuration Release recovered the schema check. Provide a check wrapper or consistently configured run target so the manual build/check path does not need this extra configuration step.

title: Preflight Windows toolchain availability before native VIXEN builds
body: The queued native attempt used cmd.exe /c call .tmp/lookdev-run2-native-build.bat and failed before configure because C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe is absent. The documented vixen-wsl configure/build/capture route then passed. Add an early vswhere/MSVC preflight with a clear supported fallback so native-first guidance does not consume a build slot before discovering the host lacks Visual Studio.

title: Propagate cancellation through queued build process groups
body: Ctrl-C stopped the foreground monitor with exit 130 while the admitted queue payload process group kept cmake --build running and holding its slot; starting the resumed command created a duplicate build. Recovery required locating the orphaned process group and sending SIGINT to its negative PGID. Make cancellation reach the queued payload and have the wrapper return only after the payload exits and releases its reservation.

title: Bind shared capture baselines to a fresh source SHA
body: The first comparison assembled a shared capture set from ignored prior outputs without source provenance; some headless and Cel images were stale/blank, so the pixel result was invalid. Recovery required detached exact-SHA clones, fresh scoped builds, and rerunning capture producers. Provide a queued baseline capture command that records source SHA, build provenance, and the exact manifest alongside the images.

title: Track generated GLSL includes in shader reflection targets
body: The SpatialReuseShade reflection SPIR-V custom command depended on root shader .glsl files but omitted shaders/Generated/*.glsl, so rebuilding after a LightingConfig schema change reused stale reflection data and failed LightingConfigSdiParity. Suggested consolidation: derive transitive shader include dependencies or include generated shader directories in the dependency graph.

title: Use the available Python 3 launcher for capture comparison
body: The queued witness command python tools/compare-capture-pixels.py SOURCE TARGET --require-byte-identical failed with exit 127 because this laptop has no python alias, while python3 is available. Suggested consolidation: make the comparison tool directly executable or resolve a Python 3 interpreter in the documented capture workflow. Workaround used: invoke it with python3.

title: Align consolidation proposal instructions with SPT category requirements
body: The lane rule's example proposal command uses --tag consolidation alone. The current SPT CLI rejected that exact form with 'task proposals need at least one declared category tag'. Retrying with --tag audit --tag consolidation succeeded. Suggested consolidation: update the lane rule to include a declared category tag or let consolidation satisfy the category requirement.

title: Derive the engine witness check-target set
body: The shared engine-lane witness states 22 *_check targets, while this worktree exposes 23, including no_new_mutex_check. I had to enumerate the target list with cmake --build build/wsl --target help and invoke all 23 to ensure the witness scope. Suggested consolidation: derive the witness target list from CMake or provide an aggregate check target so the shared instructions do not rely on a stale manual count.
